decisions.reason: Adding the hole-to-hole functional dimension and retaining the bracketed overall dimension does not change assembly-aligned drawing numbering.
The dimension-content decision does not replace or modify the client-supplied drawing setup reference.
The required dimensions and bracket presentation do not alter the established color treatment for drawing views.
The PDF-first approval sequence is independently established by another clause of message 83 and is not changed by the dimension decision.
The dimension-content modification does not change the required drawing file formats; those formats are independently addressed by another clause of message 83.
Adding a functional dimension while retaining the overall dimension does not revoke or modify compliance with the usual ČSN/EN standards.
The source decision concerns which geometric dimensions to display, not the surface-finish value or tolerance-field callout.
The hole-to-hole and overall drawing dimensions do not change the bushing's location, retention, motion, fit, or contact surface.
The source decision does not address the thread-relief groove's presence, location, or unresolved width.
The dimensional drawing change does not alter the 3D model formats or native editable artifacts; those are independently specified elsewhere in message 83.
Changing the dimensions displayed on the drawing does not modify the main-shaft material, premachining, welding, or final-machining process.
The source dimension decision does not change the requirement to omit the keyway at cross section C-C.
